name: 6ixenality
tagline: A sensor-driven 'personality mirror' that reads pose, pressure and surroundings and answers with music and meaning.

awards: MLH: Best Use of Gemini API

problem: The team wanted a device that responds to a person's presence, not just data.
solution: A Raspberry Pi on a real-time OS reads sensors and camera input, and an LLM maps them to a personality reading and music.
demo_moment: Team-described: stand in front of it and get a personality reading with a soundtrack.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “MLH: Best Use of Gemini API” among 131 submissions.
Playful mash-up of senses and personality types.

lessons: Personality quizzes are an easy hook for an interactive installation.
